otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.spec_provides_via: External SII EEPROM (1 Kbit-4 Mbit, I²C-compatible 2-wire), NOT on-chip OTP. The SII EEPROM holds the ESI (EtherCAT Slave Information) descriptor that the ESC reads at power-up. Some ESC ASICs offer optional on-chip backup SII (PDI-emulated SII) for low-cost designs.

factory_burned_typical_fields.name: Vendor ID
factory_burned_typical_fields.description: ETG-assigned vendor identifier; mirrored at CoE OD 0x1018:1.

factory_burned_typical_fields.name: Product Code
factory_burned_typical_fields.description: Vendor-defined product identifier; mirrored at CoE OD 0x1018:2.

factory_burned_typical_fields.name: Revision Number
factory_burned_typical_fields.description: Hardware/firmware revision; mirrored at CoE OD 0x1018:3.

factory_burned_typical_fields.name: Serial Number
factory_burned_typical_fields.description: Per-device serial number (optional); mirrored at CoE OD 0x1018:4.

factory_burned_typical_fields.name: Bootstrap Mailbox Configuration
factory_burned_typical_fields.description: Boot-state SM0/SM1 default config (size + address + flags).

factory_burned_typical_fields.name: Mailbox Protocols Supported
factory_burned_typical_fields.description: Bitmask: bit 0 AoE, bit 1 EoE, bit 2 CoE, bit 3 FoE, bit 4 SoE, bit 5 VoE.

factory_burned_typical_fields.name: EEPROM Size Indicator
factory_burned_typical_fields.description: SII EEPROM capacity (Kbit-1) — used by MainDevice to limit reads.

factory_burned_typical_fields.name: Configured Station Alias
factory_burned_typical_fields.description: Persistent secondary station address (loaded into 0x0012 on power-up if alias-enable bit set in DL Control).

factory_burned_typical_fields.name: PDI Control
factory_burned_typical_fields.description: Selects PDI type and basic configuration.

factory_burned_typical_fields.name: Default FMMU mappings (FMMU0..FMMU2)
factory_burned_typical_fields.description: Optional defaults written by MainDevice during start-up — typically the SII just declares the FMMU count, not the values.

esi_xml_descriptor_required.schema: ETG.2000 EtherCAT Slave Information XML schema
esi_xml_descriptor_required.purpose: Machine-readable representation of the SII EEPROM contents plus richer engineering meta-data (per-device PDO mapping, CoE Object Dictionary skeleton, etc.). MainDevice configuration tools (TwinCAT, CODESYS, EC-Engineer, etc.) consume the ESI XML.

notes: Some ESCs (e.g. Beckhoff ET1100) treat the SII as the canonical OTP-equivalent: SII is loaded into hardware Vendor-ID/Product-Code/Revision/Serial registers (mirrored at ESC offsets 0x0008-0x000F when the ESC supports the optional SII auto-load feature). Without auto-load, the MainDevice (and the local µC) must explicitly read SII via the SII Control/Status registers (0x0500-0x050F). EtherCAT P / EtherCAT G do not introduce new OTP fields.
